g1_1_business.what_it_does: Poonawalla Fincorp is a tech-enabled non-banking financial company (NBFC) that provides a range of financial products including personal loans, gold loans, consumer durable financing, commercial vehicle loans, education loans, and business loans. The company operates a digital-first retail lending platform, leveraging technology to enhance customer experience and streamline loan processing.

customers.description: Businesses looking for loans and financing options.

manufacturing.description: The company operates 400 gold branches and a digital platform for loan disbursement.

competitive_advantage: Strong technology integration with 76 AI projects deployed.
Established brand legacy through the Poonawalla Group.
Extensive distribution network with 400 branches and 12,500 dealers.

drivers.title: New Product Launches
drivers.fact: The company launched 6 new product lines that contribute significantly to disbursements.
drivers.why_it_matters: These new products are expected to drive revenue growth and increase market share.
drivers.evidence_quote: New products contributed 24% of total disbursements in Q4FY26.

drivers.title: Growing AUM
drivers.why_it_matters: This growth indicates strong demand for Poonawalla's products and services.

drivers.title: NIM Expansion
drivers.why_it_matters: Higher NIM indicates improved profitability and pricing power.
